name: Amazon
one_liner: Amazon operates a global online marketplace and service platform connecting retail buyers with third-party product sellers, advertisers, and digital content creators.
what_you_sell: Online marketplace listing services, shipping and fulfillment software, advertising space, self-publishing tools, and business purchasing solutions.
target_group: Amazon targets physical product brands, third-party merchants, and consumer goods manufacturers that want to sell products online. These businesses typically range from emerging consumer brands to established wholesale product companies with shippable inventory. A good prospect is a business with physical products suited for e-commerce distribution seeking a high-traffic sales channel and logistics support.
b2c_note: While Amazon's main website serves retail consumers, its primary paid business revenue model includes third-party sellers, advertisers, vendors, and business procurement buyers.
who_uses_it: Individual consumers shopping for physical goods, streaming digital content, or ordering household items.
who_pays_for_it: Third-party merchants, product brands, publishers, and advertisers paying listing fees, transaction cuts, fulfillment fees, and ad placements.
who_buys_it: Consumer product brands, independent merchants, manufacturers, and digital content creators looking to sell products or advertise online.
